g.title: observation
g.text: Current observations: native liveness, screen, completion and answer

g.title: meta
g.text: Strict session / active launch metadata
validate paths, generation, lineage, saved home
no newest-file fallback

g.title: native
g.text: pty_observe: native listing + pane + process table
select one harness; PID / birth / argv digest
missing / dead / ambiguous / unknown stay distinct

g.title: dormant
g.text: Dormant record / recipe / no native rechecked
hibernated only with matching evidence
otherwise unknown; discard old activity delta

g.title: wait
g.text: observeAgentDone / aiterm-wait
fixed launch + cursor / operation / steer
Claude input_id: match marker and Stop ID
wait for pre-input reservation, then saved transcript offset

g.title: answer
g.text: readAgentTranscriptResult
match completion / session / launch / turn / operation
recover late harness binding, then read native answer

g.title: screen
g.text: Capture screen → harness pane parser
busy / idle / blocked / unknown
activity digest + CPU delta with same pane birth

g.title: terminal
g.text: Ordinary pty_read
screen OR log range/increment + read offset
optional sentinel / until / shell settle / timeout

g.title: screen->terminal
g.text: screen sampling only

g.title: host
g.text: MCP content / structuredContent / optional host _meta
BellTeam owns presentation and job completion
no liveness → turn success → display shortcut

g.title: end
g.text: done / error / closed / rate_limited
running (timeout=0) / timeout / not_taken
abort only stops observer

g.title: failure
g.text: Optional failure: capacity / rate_limited / transient / other
started or unknown; never infer not_started
original observation boundary or null; turn terminal only
future_effects unknown: no queue / producer fence

g.title: end->failure
g.text: failed turns

g.title: activity
g.text: done/error: append turn_end + request idle clock
record failure does not erase completion
waiter does not own metadata binding or send lock

g.title: end->answer
g.text: done only for answer capture

g.title: end->host
g.text: typed result, no answer inferred

g.title: failure->host
g.text: preserved by parent capture / receipt

g.title: body
g.text: text + answer_empty + correlation fields
empty answer distinct from unavailable
raw text for parent delivery; display for humans

g.title: diagnostics
g.text: diagnostics {}: fixed factory v1 + parent hooks
format:v2 opts into PTY safe reason_code
no PTY creation / no raw path or stderr

g.title: probe
g.text: Read-only scoped native list
shared 5000ms subprocess budget incl. resolution
exact code/stdout/socket absence or unverified

g.title: probe->host
g.text: ready / not_applicable / unverified
